name: prop-pod
about: The title's containment hall: the stasis pod a defeated boss stands in (one design, twelve times down the hall, drawn in one call). Tripo v3.1 at its highest settings from concept prop-pod-sd-0, one attempt. The game keeps its base and cap and draws the glass and struts itself (clear, so the boss shows). Simplified to 5.2K triangles: it is drawn twelve times, and its dense base and cables were most of the hall's triangles.
bar: the game's one quality bar (2026-11-17): a prop seen up close: 1024 px colour, 512 px other maps, up to 25K triangles
